descriptionPlain:
Mobileye is looking for an Algorithm Developer Student to join our Calibration Team, part of the Geometry Group within the Algorithms R&D department. We are looking for excellent CS students, with strong problem-solving abilities, who are proactive, energetic, hard working and with a can-do attitude to help us solve hard problems and deliver world class calibration solutions. 
We develop cutting-edge computational geometry products for Mobileye systems, essential for understanding vehicle surroundings and advancing AV (Autonomous Vehicles) and ADAS (Advanced Driving Assistance Systems).
Our work combines computational geometry, mathematics, physics, software engineering, and modern AI-assisted development methodologies to deliver high-performance, real-time solutions. While our algorithms are primarily based on classical geometric and optical principles, we also leverage Machine Learning techniques to further enhance calibration accuracy.
We are passionate about building clean, reliable, and maintainable software, creating internal development tools, and continuously improving engineering productivity.

descriptionPlain:
Our vision Localization group is responsible for accurately localizing the vehicle on a high-definition 3D map with centimeter-level precision using surround camera systems to enable autonomous driving. Our work combines advanced geometric reasoning, scene understanding, and large-scale mapping to solve one of the core challenges of autonomous vehicles in complex real-world environments.
The role involves developing algorithmic and deep learning solutions that integrate mathematical optimization, computer vision, and 3D geometry. We work with modern neural network architectures including Transformers, GNNs, and CNNs to solve problems involving scene understanding, object association, and precise spatial reasoning in dynamic environments. The HD map contains rich geometric and semantic information that is critical for safe driving and cannot always be inferred reliably from images alone under all visibility conditions or viewpoints. In addition to achieving highly accurate localization, the team is also responsible for estimating map relevance and consistency with the current world state to ensure safe and reliable autonomous driving.

lists.text: What will your job look like:
lists.content:
• Develop state-of-the-art localization algorithms for autonomous driving using multi-camera surround vision systems.
  • Design and implement deep learning models based on Transformers, Graph Neural Networks, and Convolutional Neural Networks.
  • Solve challenging problems involving 3D geometry, scene understanding, object matching, and spatial reasoning.
  • Combine learning-based methods with classical optimization and geometric algorithms.
  • Own the entire lifecycle from prototyping to deployment.
  • Analyze real-world driving data and improve system robustness under diverse environmental and visibility conditions.
  • Drive innovative solutions for high-precision localization at production scale.

• 2+ years of practical experience developing computer vision or machine learning solutions using Python and frameworks such as PyTorch or TensorFlow – must.
  • B.Sc. or M.Sc. in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field, with strong academic performance.
  • Solid foundation in algorithms, data structures, and computer vision/deep learning fundamentals.
  • Strong analytical skills, a sense of ownership, and the ability to work collaboratively.

descriptionPlain:
We are seeking a Strategic Account Manager based in India to lead sales and commercial activities with strategic Indian automotive OEMs and Tier 1 suppliers in the advanced driver-assistance systems (ADAS) ecosystem.
You will own key customer relationships and manage complex, long-cycle sales opportunities—from early engagement and positioning through requests for information and quotation (RFI/RFQ), commercial negotiation, and execution. Working closely with our global teams, you will translate our advanced system-on-chip (SoC) and software solutions for ADAS applications into clear business value for customers.
This role combines hands-on account management, strategic sales, and coordination across customer procurement, engineering, program management, and executive stakeholders.

lists.text: What will your job look like?
lists.content:
• Manage and grow strategic automotive OEM accounts in India.
  • Build strong relationships with customer procurement, engineering, and senior leadership teams.
  • Lead long-cycle sales opportunities from RFI/RFQ through pricing, negotiation, and deal closure.
  • Be the main commercial contact for customers and explain the business value of our ADAS solutions.
  • Work with global teams to move deals forward, support customer programs, and maintain accurate sales forecasts.
  • Travel within India, with occasional international travel and collaboration across time zones.

• 5+ years in account management or technical sales in automotive technology, semiconductors, or a related high-tech industry.
  • BA in engineering, business, or a related field
  • Experience using Salesforce or a similar CRM.
  • Experience working with Indian automotive OEMs or Tier 1 suppliers and understanding their purchasing processes.
  • A track record of managing long sales cycles, negotiating commercial terms, and building senior customer relationships.
  • Experience with hardware and software programs, plus an understanding of automotive ADAS technologies.
  • Strong commercial and analytical skills, including pricing and volume forecasting.
  • Excellent English and the ability to take ownership and work independently with global teams.

• An established network within Indian automotive OEMs and Tier 1 suppliers.
  • Experience selling ADAS, semiconductor, embedded software, or automotive compute solutions.
  • An MBA or familiarity with Jira.
